column1: # Resident Evil (HD remaster) 1.0.0 (base game v0), SDK 5, MT Framework / NVN.
# 2026-11-10: ported on macOS arm64 (19,060 shaders from sc/NX_64 root, Title and Game; a 14.6 GB data pack).
# 2026-11-10: Lenovo Legion Y700 (2023) TB320FC, Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, Adreno 730 (driver 0615.96), Android 15: boots to the title screen and its movies at 30 fps
# (GPU 8.9 ms a frame, 670 MB), with sound (SDK 5's DeviceSink, hle_audren.c). On its 144 Hz panel a 30 fps game got a 48 Hz frame-rate override and judder;
# the app now picks the 120 Hz mode (front_android.c display_mode) and paces to the panel's 11.5 ms presentation deadline (gfx_vk_present.c pace_latch).
# Measured with devtools/perf_bench.py (budget devtools/perf_budgets/y700_2023.json): pacing jitter 7.0 -> 3.1 ms, 1% low 19.6 -> 23.7 fps, power 8.3 -> 7.1 W.
# 2026-11-10: live frame limits tested through new-game setup and the opening mansion scene: SurfaceFlinger averages 30.0 / 60.0 FPS
# (15 s samples); 60 FPS p50 16.67 ms, p99 24.99 ms, no stutters. Unlimited reaches about 62 FPS in menus.
# Prerendered movies retain 30 FPS. Touch/controller selection, restart persistence and background/resume checked. Full gameplay and saves not validated.
# 2026-11-11: TB320FC / Adreno 730 / Android 15: cold-loaded existing typewriter save slot 1 with Chris visible before opening status/map, and checked movement.
# gfx_vk_tex.c now initializes prefilled ordinary 2D textures for tex_dirty_upload profiles; the room's R32F depth previously stayed zero and hid Chris.
# Saved to empty slot 3 and cold-loaded it with the release build; Chris remained visible at 30/60 FPS, across dining-room camera changes and entering the west corridor.
